records.text: Unidentified email tipsters, as summarized by Owens, claimed participation and proof of million-dollar anti-Candace video bounties during the Tyler Robinson preliminary-hearing week, with assignments distributed on Discord; Owens described the email amount as $1.5 million. The tipsters are represented collectively and their identities and number are unverified.
records.speaker: Clipping-campaign email tipsters (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: People are being funded to attack others. We were sent emails from people who claimed that they had participated and had proof that an impossibly high bounty of money went out over the Internet, millions of dollars for people to make videos about me during that week, the preliminary hearing of Tyler Robinson, and that this money was being orchestrated by. ... Discord. The assignment was going out on Discord. I was like, Discord, really? I mean, I'll plead a little bit of millennial ignorance here. ... The email informed us again that it was millions. ... $1.5 million being offered to make anti-Candace videos here, there, this week, the other week. What? So I'm going to now walk you guys through how it works. We've confirmed this.
